name: Ekovest Berhad
overview: 2026年，Ekovest 终止了与中国深圳茂雄及安溪县政府签署的跨境社会经济合作备忘录，并通过子公司 Tanahmas Kapital 以 RM75.48 million 出售柔佛新山一幅 11.179 英亩土地。公司同时进行可放弃配售新股集资，并延长向 EPF 出售 Konsortium Lebuhraya Utara-Timur (KL) 40% 股权的退出计划一年。
overview_en: In 2026, Ekovest terminated the cross-border socio-economic collaboration MOU with Shenzhen Maoxiong and Anxi County Government, and disposed of an 11.179-acre freehold land in Johor Bahru via subsidiary Tanahmas Kapital for RM75.48 million. The company also undertook a renounceable rights issue and extended the exit plan for the disposal of its 40% equity interest in Konsortium Lebuhraya Utara-Timur (KL) to EPF by one year.

segments.name: 产业发展与投资
segments.note: 今年通过子公司出售柔佛新山一幅土地，并终止一项跨境产业与农业合作备忘录。
segments.note_en: This year, the group disposed of a parcel of land in Johor Bahru via a subsidiary and terminated a cross-border property and agriculture collaboration MOU.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Shenzhen Maoxiong Co Ltd 及 Anxi County People's Government 共同终止跨境社会经济合作备忘录，该备忘录涉及中国与马来西亚的产业发展、基建及农产品加工分销。
actions.text_en: Mutually terminated the cross-border socio-economic collaboration MOU with Shenzhen Maoxiong Co Ltd and Anxi County People's Government, which covered property development, infrastructure and fresh produce processing and distribution in China and Malaysia.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 Tanahmas Kapital 以 RM75,483,068.70 出售柔佛新山一幅约 11.179 英亩永久地契土地给 City Version Sdn Bhd。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Tanahmas Kapital disposed of an approximately 11.179-acre freehold land in Johor Bahru to City Version Sdn Bhd for RM75,483,068.70.

segments.name: 收费公路运营
segments.note: 向 EPF 出售 Konsortium Lebuhraya Utara-Timur (KL) 40% 股权的退出计划获延长一年。
segments.note_en: The exit plan for the disposal of 40% equity interest in Konsortium Lebuhraya Utara-Timur (KL) to EPF was extended by one year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 向 EPF 出售 Konsortium Lebuhraya Utara-Timur (KL) 40% 股权的退出计划获 EPF 批准延长一年至 2027 年 2 月 12 日。
actions.text_en: EPF approved a one-year extension of the exit plan for the disposal of 40% equity interest in Konsortium Lebuhraya Utara-Timur (KL) to 12 February 2027.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成可放弃配售新股集资，并寻求股东更新 recurrent related party transactions 的授权。
segments.note_en: The group completed a renounceable rights issue and sought shareholders' renewal of the mandate for recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: RENOUNCEABLE RIGHTS ISSUE OF 1,779,246,481 NEW ORDINARY SHARES IN EKOVEST BERHAD ("EKOVEST SHARE") ("RIGHTS SHARE") AT AN ISSUE PRICE OF RM0
actions.text: 完成可放弃配售 1,779,246,481 股新股，发售价每股 RM0.20。
actions.text_en: Completed renounceable rights issue of 1,779,246,481 new shares at RM0.20 per share on the basis of 3 rights shares for every 5 existing shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以在即将举行的第 41 届年度股东大会上寻求批准。
actions.text_en: Proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions to be tabled at the forthcoming 41st AGM.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
